## Appendix

```{r}
#| label: appendix
#| fig-cap: "Appendix figures and tables."

#Figure A1: Correlation matrix
corrplot::corrplot(cor(wdi %>% select(-any_of("cluster"))),
                   method = "color", type = "upper", tl.cex = 0.5)

#Figure A2: Elbow plot 
fviz_nbclust(pca_scores, kmeans, method = "wss")

#Table A1: PCA loadings
round(pca$rotation[, 1:5], 2) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  knitr::kable()

#Table A2: Cluster means
wdi %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  pivot_longer(-cluster) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = cluster, values_from = value) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 2)
```
